identificationModule.briefTitle: Envafolimab Combined With Endostatin in Recurrent or Metastatic MSS-type Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Single-arm, Multicenter Clinical Trial of Envafolimab Combined With Recombinant Human Endostatin (Endostatin) in the Treatment of Recurrent or Metastatic MSS-type Colorectal Cancer

leadSponsor.name: First Affiliated Hospital Xi'an Jiaotong University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The objective is to investigate the efficacy and safety of envafolimab combined with recombinant human endostatin (endostatin) in the treatment of MSS-type colorectal cancer patients with recurrence or metastasis after failure of second-line standard therapy.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is a multicenter, prospective, single-arm clinical study. That is, eligible colorectal cancer patients, after signing the informed consent form, are screened into the group, and will receive continuous intravenous infusion of envafolimab (envafolimab) combined with recombinant human endostatin (endostatin) until the disease. Progressive or intolerable.
